summary_1line: Bhima battles the rakshasa Hidimva in the forest while Hidimva’s sister confesses love for Bhima and reveals the attack to Kunti and the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima lifts the blue-skinned rakshasa Hidimva high into the air and whirls him repeatedly amid shattered trees in the dark forest.
Bhima and Hidimva grapple like enraged elephants, tearing trees and raising clouds of dust that shroud them like mist around cliffs.
The Pandavas and Kunti awaken in the forest to see the beautiful rakshasi Hidimva standing before them while Bhima battles her brother in the distance.
